semantic_orientation.description: The blind socket opening is treated as the functional front. The long arm extends primarily toward the semantic right, while its broad planar faces define top and bottom. This interpretation is semantic and is not derived solely from camera labels.

sections.name: Lever arm section
sections.description: Long plate-like structural arm extending from the socket region toward x=80 mm and terminating in a shorter rounded end toward x=-25 mm.
sections.location: Extends along the CAD X direction from the rounded end through the socket attachment region to the long free end; nominal plate bounds are y=11 to 23 mm and z=2 to 6 mm.

section_functions.name: Transfer applied load
section_functions.description: Transfers force and moment between the long arm and the integral socket region.

section_functions.name: Support socket boss
section_functions.description: Provides the structural base supporting the transverse cylindrical boss.

section_behaviors.name: Resist arm bending
section_behaviors.description: The elongated plate reacts bending generated by loads applied away from the socket axis.

section_behaviors.name: Carry transverse shear
section_behaviors.description: Carries shear between the free arm and the socket attachment region.

features.name: Elongated lever web
features.description: Constant-thickness plate-like web forming most of the 105 mm overall X-span. Its broad planar surfaces are at z=2 mm and z=6 mm, with long side walls at y=11 mm and y=23 mm.

feature_functions.name: Transfer lever load
feature_functions.description: Carries applied force and bending moment along the lever span.

feature_behaviors.name: Resist bending
feature_behaviors.description: The broad web geometry provides bending resistance along the elongated arm.

feature_behaviors.name: Carry shear
feature_behaviors.description: Transfers transverse shear toward the socket boss.

relationships.description: The lever web is integrally attached to the socket boss through the blended root.
The web meets the smooth root transition beneath the boss.

brep_faces.name: Lower broad arm face
brep_faces.description: Broad planar face on z=2 mm forming one principal surface of the lever web.
evidence: CadQuery reports a PLANE with area 1164.352266 mm^2.
Plane normal is (0,0,-1) and the bounding box spans x=-25 to 80 mm, y=11 to 23 mm at z=2 mm.
The rendered views show this as a major broad surface of the elongated arm.

brep_faces.name: Upper broad arm face
brep_faces.description: Broad planar face on z=6 mm forming the opposite principal surface of the lever web.
evidence: CadQuery reports a PLANE with area 1164.317039 mm^2.
Plane normal is (0,0,1) and the bounding box spans x=-25 to 80 mm, y=11 to 23 mm at z=6 mm.
Its extent and parallel relationship to FACE 1 identify the nominal 4 mm web thickness.

brep_faces.name: Long rear arm side wall
brep_faces.description: Continuous longitudinal side wall at y=11 mm.
evidence: CadQuery reports a 420 mm^2 planar face spanning x=-25 to 80 mm and z=2 to 6 mm.
The face lies at constant y=11 mm.

brep_faces.name: Long front arm side wall
brep_faces.description: Longitudinal side wall at y=23 mm extending from the boss region to the x=80 mm terminal end.
evidence: CadQuery reports a planar face at y=23 mm.
Bounding box spans x=6.602720 to 80 mm and z=2 to 6 mm.

brep_faces.name: Short front-side wall segment
brep_faces.description: Small residual segment of the y=23 mm arm side wall adjacent to the boss transition on the rounded-end side.
evidence: CadQuery reports a planar face at y=23 mm with z bounds 2 to 6 mm.
Its x bounds, -8.386753 to -6.602720 mm, place it beside the boss transition.

brep_faces.name: Long-arm terminal face
brep_faces.description: Planar end face closing the long free end of the lever web at x=80 mm.
evidence: CadQuery reports a 48 mm^2 planar face at x=80 mm.
Bounding dimensions are 12 mm in Y and 4 mm in Z, matching the arm cross-section.

features.name: Rounded short-end profile
features.description: Large-radius cylindrical side surface forming the rounded termination of the arm opposite the long free end.

feature_functions.name: Distribute end stress
feature_functions.description: Avoids an abrupt planar corner at the short end and provides a smooth terminal profile.

feature_behaviors.name: Distribute local stress
feature_behaviors.description: The curved end reduces geometric abruptness relative to a sharp rectangular termination.

relationships.description: The rounded short end transitions directly into the elongated lever web.

brep_faces.name: Rounded end wall
brep_faces.description: Partial cylindrical wall defining the arm's rounded short-end outline.
evidence: CadQuery identifies a CYLINDER of radius 17.5 mm with axis parallel to CAD Z.
The face occupies x=-25 to -8.386753 mm, y=11 to 23 mm, and z=2 to 6 mm.
The orthographic and isometric views show a rounded termination at the short end.

sections.name: Integral socket boss section
sections.description: Transverse cylindrical boss centered at x=0 mm and z=4 mm, with a blind cylindrical socket opening and a smooth enlarged transition into the lever arm.
sections.location: Mounted near the short-end side of the lever arm. The boss and bore are coaxial with the CAD Y direction and extend toward the opening plane at y=34 mm.

section_functions.name: Receive a cylindrical mating member
section_functions.description: The blind socket is inferred to receive and locate a pin, shaft end, or cylindrical tool member.

section_functions.name: Connect mating member to arm
section_functions.description: Connects a cylindrical mating member to the load-transmitting lever arm.

section_behaviors.name: React radial bearing load
section_behaviors.description: The cylindrical bore wall can react radial contact load from an inserted mating member.

section_behaviors.name: Spread boss load into arm
section_behaviors.description: The enlarged boss and blended root spread localized socket loads into the plate-like arm.

features.name: Cylindrical socket boss
features.description: Outer cylindrical material surrounding the blind bore. The principal outer radius is 7 mm about an axis parallel to CAD Y.

feature_functions.name: Support socket wall
feature_functions.description: Provides material around the blind bore and transfers contact loads to the arm.

feature_behaviors.name: React bore load
feature_behaviors.description: The boss wall reacts and distributes loads generated at the internal bore.

feature_behaviors.name: Carry boss shear
feature_behaviors.description: Carries shear from the socket interface into the root transition.

relationships.description: The outer boss radially surrounds the blind cylindrical bore.
The radius-7 mm outer boss and radius-5 mm bore share the axis through x=0 mm and z=4 mm parallel to CAD Y.
The lower end of the cylindrical boss blends into the enlarged root transition.
The cylindrical outer wall terminates at the annular opening rim.

brep_faces.name: Outer socket boss wall
brep_faces.description: Principal cylindrical exterior of the socket boss.
evidence: CadQuery reports a CYLINDER with radius 7 mm.
Cylinder axis is (0,-1,0), with x and z bounds of -7 to 7 mm.
The face extends over y=24 to 34 mm and visually corresponds to the outer tube wall.

features.name: Blind cylindrical socket bore
features.description: Blind radius-5 mm cylindrical cavity opening at y=34 mm and closed by a planar bottom at y=25 mm. The bore axis is parallel to CAD Y.

feature_functions.name: Receive cylindrical member
feature_functions.description: Receives a nominally cylindrical mating pin, shaft end, or tool member.

feature_functions.name: Locate inserted member
feature_functions.description: The cylindrical wall locates an inserted member radially while the blind bottom can establish insertion depth.

feature_behaviors.name: React radial contact load
feature_behaviors.description: The bore wall provides cylindrical bearing contact against an inserted member.

feature_behaviors.name: Constrain insertion depth
feature_behaviors.description: The planar blind bottom can constrain translation farther into the socket.

feature_behaviors.name: Permit relative rotation
feature_behaviors.description: A smooth cylindrical pin interface may permit rotation about the common bore axis if not otherwise fastened.

relationships.description: The blind bore lies inside the surrounding socket boss.
The bore opens through the inner boundary of the annular rim face.

brep_faces.name: Blind bore cylindrical wall
brep_faces.description: Internal cylindrical wall of the blind socket.
evidence: CadQuery reports a CYLINDER of radius 5 mm centered on x=0 mm and z=4 mm.
The cylinder axis is parallel to CAD Y and the face spans y=25 to 34 mm.
The rendered +Y and isometric views show the circular socket opening.

brep_faces.name: Blind bore bottom
brep_faces.description: Circular planar bottom closing the radius-5 mm socket bore at y=25 mm.
evidence: CadQuery reports a planar circular face at y=25 mm.
Area is 78.539816 mm^2, equal to the area of a radius-5 mm disk.
Its x and z bounds are -5 to 5 mm and -1 to 9 mm, matching the bore diameter.

features.name: Boss-to-arm root blend
features.description: Smooth freeform transition joining the radius-7 mm socket boss to the plate-like lever arm.

feature_functions.name: Distribute socket-root stress
feature_functions.description: Spreads loads from the localized cylindrical boss into the wider lever web.

feature_functions.name: Connect boss to arm
feature_functions.description: Provides the continuous integral material transition between boss and arm.

feature_behaviors.name: Reduce root concentration
feature_behaviors.description: The smooth enlarged transition reduces geometric discontinuity at the loaded boss root.

feature_behaviors.name: Spread boss load
feature_behaviors.description: Spreads boss loads over a broader region of the lever web.

relationships.description: The transition surface blends into the lever web around the boss base.
The transition surface blends into the cylindrical outer boss wall.
Transmits and spreads loads from the socket boss into the lever web.

brep_faces.name: Freeform boss root blend
brep_faces.description: B-spline transition surface surrounding the base of the socket boss and merging it into the arm.
evidence: CadQuery identifies the face as a BSPLINE with area 198.026029 mm^2.
Bounding box is x=-7 to 7 mm, y=19 to 24 mm, z=-3 to 11 mm.
Its bounds bridge the arm region and the radius-7 mm boss.
Rendered side and isometric views show a bulbous smooth transition beneath the cylindrical boss.

features.name: Annular socket opening seat
features.description: Planar annular end face at the socket opening, bounded by the radius-7 mm exterior and radius-5 mm bore.

feature_functions.name: Provide axial reference
feature_functions.description: Can provide an axial seating or reference face around an inserted cylindrical member.

feature_functions.name: Support mating shoulder
feature_functions.description: May support a mating shoulder or washer around the socket opening.

feature_behaviors.name: React axial contact
feature_behaviors.description: The planar annulus can react axial contact from a mating shoulder.

relationships.description: The annular opening face surrounds the entrance to the blind bore.
The annular seat is the opening-end interface of the socket boss.
The annular seat plane is perpendicular to the blind bore axis.

brep_faces.name: Annular socket rim face
brep_faces.description: Planar annular face at y=34 mm surrounding the bore opening.
evidence: CadQuery reports a planar face at y=34 mm with two wires.
Area is 75.398224 mm^2, equal to the annular area between radii 7 mm and 5 mm.
Bounding box is x=-7 to 7 mm and z=-3 to 11 mm.

part.name: Socket-ended lever arm
part.description: Single-piece mechanical lever or linkage arm with a long plate-like load arm, a rounded short end, and an integral cylindrical socket boss containing a blind bore. The boss is joined to the arm by a smooth blended root. Functional identification is inferred from geometry and rendered appearance.
part.symmetry_note: The cylindrical boss and blind bore are rotationally symmetric about their common CAD Y-axis. The arm is approximately symmetric about its mid-thickness plane z=4 mm, except where it merges into the boss. No repeated feature pattern is present.
